name: Tsukihime
source:
This story is about a young boy named [url=/c72]Toono Shiki[/url] who, after experiencing a traumatic accident, wakes up in the hospital with the ability to see lines and cracks in every surface and being. These lines, when traced with any sharp or blunt edge, will be permanently cut. As he is forced to see these lines everywhere, Shiki is distraught until he meets a mage girl who gives him glasses that allow him to live a normal life.

Years later, after living in a relative's home, the death of his father has him summoned back to the mansion he left years ago. There he must learn to live with his younger sister and two maid girls. 

One day Shiki's life takes a turn for the worse when, on the way to school, he meets a blonde woman and he's overcome with the urge to kill her.
translation:
故事的主人公是少年[url=/c72]远野志贵[/url]。经历一场严重事故后，他在医院醒来，发现自己能够看见一切物体与生命表面上的线和裂痕。只要用任何锋利或钝重的边缘沿这些线划过，对应之物便会被永久切断。无处不在的线令志贵痛苦不堪，直到他遇见一名魔法使少女。少女送给他一副眼镜，让他得以恢复正常生活。

多年后，一直寄住在亲戚家的志贵因父亲去世，被召回自己多年前离开的宅邸。在那里，他必须重新适应与妹妹及两名女仆共同生活。

一天，志贵在上学途中遇见一名金发女子，心中忽然涌起杀死她的强烈冲动。他的人生也由此急转直下。
